title: research: certify local-first two-ADD obstruction on staged544
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add only `research/staged544-local-two-add/` (20 files), at scientific commit 1416f8cd6bfb2f2eb9aa5cc22f0388a85fdbac91. This publishes fork Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds#12 without its unrelated P112 workflow repair, which is separately submitted in #3885.

On both literal PR3734 staged544 providers, certify a local-first two-ADD retiming obstruction: the first ADD changes frame in place or crosses one adjacent ADD/nonzero SCALE; the second ADD may move any distance in its allowed scalar corridor and use any legal common binary frame. Neutral and locally losing first moves are included. With fixed entrance/exit, other gates/frames, cuts and native warps, every covered combined raw rank moment is non-improving for all real 0<a<1. Intermediate and final words must obey the boundary contract.

This is an exact reduction plus a finite census and exact sign certificates, not a global two-ADD impossibility or a new kappa/frontier claim. Longer first displacements, simultaneous edits with an illegal intermediate, gate insertion/deletion, moved SCALEs, warp/phase boundaries and changed callers remain outside scope.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base: 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90, priority revision 6. Explicit user-assigned continuation of #3886; TASK.json records the refined scalar-to-moment scope, frozen inputs and original overlap search. Pins: #3734/dataisfire fa041037a3374eaa08feeca0b26a5d6893194147 and #3886 scientific 359fe0fe77d29544972fd22ee674085ed5a3b4d0. No task reroll or exhaustive novelty claim.

A fresh publication check found #3941 (scientific 001ebcdb3f86a7f9d5f5897f9cf5a84e74dd1822). Its neutral-first frame changes reach displacement two and its legal adjacent commuting swaps receive a separate census. This package overlaps the adjacent neutral domain, adds locally losing first words and their changed-frame interactions, and stops first displacement at one. Neither package contains all of the other's declared domain. Counts must not be added as disjoint cases; #3941 receives parallel-work credit.

## Validation

Per provider: 5,756 nontrivial first records; 1,047 changed-frame words give 11,903,025 interacting second cut/dimension checks, plus 14,693 new-gap cases, totaling 11,917,718 reduced prices and 49 signed histogram types. These are reduced price cases, not distinct whole circuits. Each provider separately regenerates all 1,776,295 #3886 single-move premise cases. The single-gap lemma and exhaustive subspace orientations avoid sampled-basis claims; oversized quotients fail explicitly.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3 -B research/staged544-local-two-add/verify.py --provider base
python3 -B research/staged544-local-two-add/verify.py --provider extra
python3 -B research/staged544-local-two-add/test_checks.py
python3 -O -B research/staged544-local-two-add/test_checks.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged544-local-two-add
```

Recorded CPython 3.13.5/Linux x86_64 standard-library censuses: 344.93s base and 348.66s extra. Controls include the retained exact free-operator interpreter on 632 live inputs plus 91 arbitrary dirty buffers, both orientations; independent quotient/subset enumeration on all 3,118 intervals; unpruned bridge/nonbridge comparisons; 48 SCALE-conjugation matrices; source/frame/barrier/undo rejection and predicate-disable sensitivity, normal and -O. The credited #2957 2+3 -> 1+4 recovery remains a positive control. VALIDATION.json distinguishes source-bound receipts, local schema validation with Git-pin checking disabled, and incomplete preliminary exploration that is not theorem evidence.

[Hosted fork replay](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39200158512) passed on mixed head 01742f8a36698f561a0fd474e8a87110fc3a76c7, whose research bytes are unchanged. That fork run is separate from the exact-head upstream evidence below. Fresh native Clifford/phase, allocation, precision/stock, all-size compiler, supplier/outer, analytic and BIT admission are unrun; no human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.

### Passing upstream CI

[Upstream run 39205949093](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39205949093) passed at exact scientific head 1416f8cd6bfb2f2eb9aa5cc22f0388a85fdbac91: planning, both full provider censuses, normal and optimized control suites, and committed-input preservation. The research replay job completed in 15m31s. No repair commit was needed. This confirms registered execution; independent scientific review and the remaining admission obligations are still open.

## Credit

Retain #3886, dataisfire/#3734, Jeremy Kothe/#2957 and #2979, Dugongue/#3863 and staged-entry/retiming lineage; Sagar Thakrar's auditor, roger-sato's adapter and Arham Tahir's frame-contract attribution. Reused interpreters are credited predecessor tools. Chris R / Clear1nsight prepared the new reductions, census and package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0 and retained source notices apply.

## Open next questions

See README.md and TASK.json. The smallest useful extension is a literal legal first move across at least two neighbours (especially a losing first move beyond this domain), followed by its complete interacting second-move invoice. Coordinated frame changes or changed boundaries need separate contracts. Each requires before/after words, arbitrary-dirty restoration and a full paid bill before any improvement claim.

### Community uptake and coordination

The [scoped community handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166?sort=new#discussioncomment-19032637) gives the exact source, established result, remaining uncertainty, concrete next tasks, reproduction/runtime and predecessor credit. Independent review of the interaction/new-gap reduction and simultaneous edits outside the legal-intermediate contract are available for others to take on. Reply there with a bounded scope and investigation link, and report results here.

The displacement-exactly-two losing-first extension has a [separate live claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166?sort=new#discussioncomment-19032051), recorded expiry 2026-10-19T06:54:18Z; check current status and coordinate before duplicating it. This update does not override that claim. Check live overlap, including #3941 and changed-contract #3945, before starting.
